display.purpose: h1 and wide-viewport plant names, Bricolage Grotesque 650.

headline.purpose: h2, mobile tag header names, watering band fact values.

body.purpose: Running text in Figtree, capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Chips, pills, captions and status lines.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Cards and tags at rest. Dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35).

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Card hover on pointer devices and floating action buttons. Dark: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.45).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing for hover, press, entry and confirmation.

motion.name: water-fill
motion.purpose: Teal wash across the watering band after Water now succeeds.

motion.name: value-settle
motion.purpose: Fact values settle in after watering.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.value: 250ms ease-out, translateY(-3px) with shadow-lift, hover: hover only

components.name: Water Now Button
components.description: The one primary action of the watering status band.
components.css: .ds-water-now { background: var(--ion-color-tertiary, #0e6b75); color: var(--ion-color-tertiary-contrast, #fff); min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); font: 650 1rem var(--font-body, system-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-water-now:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-water-now:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #0e6b75); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-water-now:active { filter: brightness(0.94); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ion-color-primary, #1f6b3b); color: var(--ion-color-primary-contrast, #fff); min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); font: 650 1rem var(--font-body, system-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ion-color-primary-shade, #1b5e34); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #0e6b75); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Plant Tag Card
components.description: List card: photo, dashed perforation with hole, name, species and watering status.
components.css: .ds-tag-card { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 240px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-tag-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); } .ds-tag-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #0e6b75); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tag-media { display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: var(--tint-1, #cfe5d3); } .ds-tag-body { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 16px 12px 12px; border-top: 2px dashed var(--line, #d5dfd2); } .ds-tag-hole { position: absolute; top: -7px; left: 50%; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-left: -6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-sunken, #e6ede2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line, #d5dfd2); } .ds-tag-name { font: 650 1rem/1.2 var(--font-display, system-ui); color: var(--ion-text-color, #1d2b22); } .ds-tag-sub { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5d52); } .ds-chip-due { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ion-color-tertiary, #0e6b75); color: var(--ion-color-tertiary-contrast, #fff); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Plant Tag Header
components.description: Detail screen name tag with side hole, species and visibility chip.
components.css: .ds-tag-header { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 16px 16px 48px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px) var(--radius-lg, 22px) var(--radius-lg, 22px) var(--radius-md, 14px); background: var(--leaf-wash, #dcebdf); color: var(--ion-text-color, #1d2b22); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); } .ds-hole { position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-sunken, #e6ede2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line, #d5dfd2); } .ds-tag-title { margin: 0; font: 650 1.625rem/1.15 var(--font-display, system-ui); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-tag-species { margin: 4px 0 0; font-style: italic; color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5d52); } .ds-chip-public { justify-self: start; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--water-wash, #dcf0f2); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Watering Status Band
components.description: Last watered and interval facts with the Water now action.

components.css: .ds-status { display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); background: var(--water-wash, #dcf0f2); color: var(--ion-text-color, #1d2b22); } .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 0; } .ds-facts dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5d52); } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; } .ds-fact { font: 650 1.625rem/1.2 var(--font-display, system-ui); } .ds-water { min-height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); background: var(--ion-color-tertiary, #0e6b75); color: var(--ion-color-tertiary-contrast, #fff); font: 650 1rem var(--font-body, system-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-water:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #0e6b75); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Outline input with 44px height, line border and teal focus.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; width: 260px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line, #d5dfd2); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); color: var(--ion-text-color, #1d2b22); font: 400 1rem var(--font-body, system-ui); caret-color: var(--ion-color-primary, #1f6b3b); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5d52); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #0e6b75); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--focus-ring, #0e6b75); }

components.name: State Block
components.description: Empty state: tinted illustration well, title, message and one next step.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-state { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; } .ds-art { width: 148px; height: 148px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 22px); background: var(--tint-1, #cfe5d3); } .ds-state-title { margin: 0; font: 650 1.25rem/1.15 var(--font-display, system-ui); } .ds-state-msg { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #4d5d52); } .ds-btn-primary { margin-top: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); background: var(--ion-color-primary, #1f6b3b); color: var(--ion-color-primary-contrast, #fff); font: 650 1rem var(--font-body, system-ui); }

narrative.overview: An Ionic Vue app restyled so that watering is the hero and every plant wears a painted tag. Leaf green carries brand and primary actions on a sage-white ground (not cream); fired clay marks fertilizer, "new" and overdue; water teal marks watering. Dark mode is a moss-black counterpart, not an inversion. Headings are set in Bricolage Grotesque, body in Figtree. The look is warm and botanical, calm and legible one-handed next to a plant.
keyCharacteristics: Role colors are semantic: green acts, teal waters, clay flags fertilizer, new and overdue.
Every plant has an identity: a tag, and when no photo exists an authored leaf silhouette on a tint keyed to the plant.
One primary action per screen region, 44px minimum targets, 52px for Water now.
Light and dark both first-class, switched only by the ion-palette-dark class.

rules.name: The Role Color Rule
rules.body: Green means act, teal means water, clay means fertilizer, new or overdue. Never swap them to decorate.

rules.name: The Never-Only-Color Rule
rules.body: Status is always color plus text or icon (chip label, status line); chart series differ in lightness and hue and are never the only code.

rules.name: The Tokens-Only Rule
rules.body: Components read variables; no hex colors or inline style attributes in components (the placeholder tint binds through var(--tint-n)).

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display face for names and headings only; Figtree for everything else, including buttons (650, no uppercase, no letter-spacing).

rules.name: The Rests-On-The-Bench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry the card shadow at rest; only hover (pointer devices) and floating buttons step up to lift. Dark mode keeps the same two steps with black shadows.

dos: Do put Water now above the fold on plant detail, in teal, 52px tall, as the single primary action of the band.
Do build icon-only actions with IconButton and an outline icon from theme/icons.ts.
Do route every state (loading, empty, error, not found) through StateBlock and offer the next step.
Do use var(--token) for color, space, radius and shadow, and add dark values in the same change.
Do show an authored placeholder with a per-item tint when an image is missing or fails.
donts: Don't reintroduce the stock Ionic starter look: anonymous white cards, grey headings, broken-image glyphs.
Don't use clay or teal for decoration; they carry meaning.
Don't switch dark mode with a media query; the class is the only source.
Don't use the display face for body copy, buttons or form labels.
Don't use uppercase letter-spaced labels, colored offset shadows, or filled icons for anything other than selected tabs.
